sloka: निरानंदा निराशा अहम् निमग्ना शोक सागरे ।त्वयि पंचत्वम् आपन्ने महायूथप यूथपे ॥४-२०-९॥
transliteration: nirānaṁdā nirāśā aham nimagnā śoka sāgare ।tvayi paṁcatvam āpanne mahāyūthapa yūthape ॥4-20-9॥

translations.english: 'You are the leader of leaders. Now that you have attained heaven I am bereft of all joy, plunged in a sea of grief.
